basic_details.job_title: DLSA Chamba Para Legal Volunteer Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for DLSA Chamba Para Legal Volunteer Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: chamba.dcourts.gov.in/.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 25-09-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DLSA Chamba Para Legal Volunteer posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Para Legal Volunteer posts is 25 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How can I apply for the DLSA Chamba Para Legal Volunteer recruitment?
faq.answer: You need to apply offline by downloading the application form from the official website and submitting it with all required documents before the last date.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for DLSA Chamba Para Legal Volunteer posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category for the DLSA Chamba Para Legal Volunteer posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the total number of vacancies for Para Legal Volunteers?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Para Legal Volunteer in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the job type for the Para Legal Volunteer position?
faq.answer: The Para Legal Volunteer position is on a contractual basis.

faq.answer: The District Legal Services Authority Chamba is located in Chamba, Himachal Pradesh.

faq.answer: The official notification does not specify age relaxation details. Please refer to the official notification for more information.
